---
name: Chat history limits
description: Safe reuse of long AI-generated media analyses in subsequent chat requests.
---

When a media-analysis response is longer than the per-message history limit, truncate it on the client before sending it back as chat history. Preserve the server-side limit for untrusted incoming requests.

**Why:** Video and photo analyses are generated by the app and can exceed the request validator's per-message limit. Sending them unchanged makes the next user message fail validation, even though the UI has accepted it.

**How to apply:** Keep the browser's history payload within the API contract and visibly report non-SSE HTTP failures instead of silently removing the assistant placeholder.

The follow-up chat must receive the entire last completed weather analysis as separate context, not as a truncated conversational message. Regional wind-system knowledge must remain available alongside it.

**Why:** The user explicitly requires access to the last analysis and winds systems. The rendered analysis is stored separately from chat text; sending only message content made the model deny access to the analysis displayed just above the question.

**How to apply:** Preserve all four sections, warnings, sources and available forecast series, including after browser restoration. Keep image binaries out of the context, bound the separate payload explicitly and report invalid or oversized context rather than silently dropping it. Replace it only when a newer complete analysis is available.
